content: Data Synthesis. Data synthesis for text summarization is underexplored, with most prior work focusing on machine translation, and text normalization. BIBREF12 proposed doing data augmentation through word replacement, using WordNet BIBREF13 and vector space similarity, respectively. We will use a WordNet replacement method as a baseline synthesis method in the experiments described below. In contrast, BIBREF14 synthesized/augmented data through back-translation and word replacement using language models. BIBREF15 is another recent work that was done in parallel and is very close to ours. However, in addition to the difference in both our and their model, we think it might be infeasible to back generate student reflections from a human summary, especially an abstractive one.
